ai.overview: The Colorado Avalanche bring the Belt Holders lineal championship to Nationwide Arena, having defended it twice in their current reign. Colorado enters riding a three-game winning streak at 9-6, while Columbus struggles at 5-7 with back-to-back losses. The belt will change hands if the Blue Jackets can upset the visiting Avalanche.

Columbus looking to capitalize on home ice after playing their last two on the road, both losses, against a Colorado team that just won 5-2 in Chicago

Our Elo model favors Colorado, aligning with both their recent form and historical dominance in this matchup.
